jobs_results.title: Backend Python
jobs_results.description:
Descripción
• *ÚNETE AL EQUIPO COMO DESARROLLADOR BACKEND PYTHON**

¿Quieres formar parte de una organización que apuesta por cuidar de las personas y su crecimiento personal y profesional?

En **Kairós DS** estamos buscando nuevos profesionales con experiência en el desarrollo con tecnologías **Backend Python, **para que se unan a nuestro equipo de Desarrollo. **Buscamos perfiles senior, apasionados del clean code y el rendimiento.**

Trabajamos en proyectos con las últimas tecnologías y nos enfocamos siempre hacia buenas prácticas, realizando tests unitarios y End2End, en un entorno de integración continua con metodologías ágiles.

Nos encanta que nuestras compañeras y compañeros enseñen a los demás y puedan aprender de las personas más expertas, y cuidamos de ti para que puedas sentirte bien en el mejor ambiente tanto profesional como personal.
• *¿Quiénes somos?**

Acompañamos a nuestros clientes en proyectos de transformación tecnológica y ágil. **Trabajamos en equipos... organizados por Capacidades y en squads multidisciplinares en proyectos muy diversos** (retail, investigación sanitaria, banca, seguridad, movilidad ).

Aunque hemos crecido mucho en el último año, no queremos olvidarnos de nuestra esencia, **centrados siempre en las personas**: hacemos seguimiento personal constante con el equipo técnico y de Talento. Además, apostamos siempre por la transparencia y la claridad.

Estamos en **España, México, EEUU, Perú, Colombia y Singapur**. En Kairós DS encontrarás proyectos en los que podrás trabajar desde casa, sin perder la cercanía con el resto del equipo
• *¿Qué podemos ofrecerte?**

Somos empresa **Great Place to Work** por segundo año consecutivo gracias a nuestros valores, nuestra cultura y a los beneficios e iniciativas internas que lanzamos centradas en las personas. Por ello, en Kairós DS encontrarás:

- **Bolsa individual de formación de 1.750 euros, **formación continua corporativa y certificaciones técnicas.
- **Clases de inglés gratuitas, en grupos reducidos.**:

- **23 días de vacaciones, 24 y 31 de diciembre libres, 1 día para eventos y 3 días de libre conciliación**:

- Posibilidad de **trabajar desde casa.**:

- Disfrutar del verano con nuestra** jornada reducida en agosto y horario intensivo todos los viernes del año.**:

- **Retribución flexible** a través de Cobee, para hacer uso en restauración, transporte público, formación y ticket guardería.
- **Seguro médico **con Cigna o Sanitas: nos preocupamos de tu salud física y mental.
- **Acompañamiento psicológico **continuo a través de nuestro programa Wellness 3.0 y mentoring técnico constante.
- **Fortalecimiento de tu marca personal** en eventos internos y externos.
- Formar parte de una **gran comunidad **y contar con el apoyo de personas increíbles y referentes dentro del sector.
- Pero sobre todo... ser parte de una empresa donde se te escucha, se te cuida y donde intentamos hacer todo lo posible por **cubrir tus necesidades y expectativas.**
• *¿Qué harás en tu día a día?**

Como **Fullstack de angular y python** tendrás un papel clave dentro de los proyectos en los que trabajes.
• *Estas serán tus funciones en el día a día**:

- Participar en **sesiones diarias o semanales** de alineamiento con el equipo.
- **Idear, identificar mejoras o implementarlas**, según proyecto.
- Trabajar mano a mano y de forma coordinada con tu **squad.**:

- Comunicarte periódicamente con tu **Head,** para trasladar tus necesidades y dibujar tu mapa de crecimiento técnico.
• *En los primeros días**
- Asistirás a una **sesión de onboarding,** en la que conocerás todo sobre Kairós DS y las personas que pueden ayudarte, así como los procesos internos, y podrás hablar directamente con los Heads de tu Capacidad y conocerlos mejor.
- Tendrás oportunidad de **preguntar cualquier duda** de manera pública o privada para resolver cualquier cuestión que te plantees.
- Te familiarizaras con las diferentes **herramientas internas.**:

- Recibirás tu **equipo informático** y, poco después, **tu kit de bienvenida** con regalos Kairoseros
- Conocerás a **tu embajador o embajadora**, tu apoyo en el cliente o espacio de trabajo en el que crecerás las primeras semanas.
• *A los 3 meses...**
- Habrás tenido oportunidad de **aterrizar poco a poco,** conociendo mejor al equipo de trabajo interno o en el cliente en el que estés trabajando.
- Ya habrás recibido notificaciones y publicaciones de **comunicación interna,** que te habrán ayudado a generar vínculos con la compañía.
- Tendrás una **sesión 1:1 con el equipo de Talento** para saber cómo están yendo estos primero meses y seguir ayudándote en tu onboarding.
- Podrás asistir a algunas de nuestras **meriendas virtuales o presenciales** de equipo.
• *A los 6 meses...**
- Habrás terminado tu onboarding y **tu adaptación dentro de Kairós DS habrá llegado al 100%** aportando todo tu talento y tu valor

jobs_results.title: Programador/a Senior BackEnd Java Spring
jobs_results.description:
Descripción

En Nunsys Group estamos creciendo a pasos agigantados y tenemos una gran oportunidad para ti. ¡Abrimos vacante para incorporar a un/a Programador/a Senior BackEnd JavaSpring en nuestro equipo de Industria Digital.

¿Cuál será tu misión?
• Diseñar y desarrollar servicios web RESTful y microservicios utilizando Spring Boot.
• Desarrollar e integrar servicios web con bases de datos relacionales y no relacionales. Así como diseñar e implementar modelos de datos utilizando Hibernate y JPA.
• Desarrollar pruebas unitarias y de integración utilizando herramientas como JUnit, Mockito y Spring Test.
• Trabajar con el equipo de Front-End para asegurar la integración y compatibilidad adecuada entre el Back-End y el Front-End.

Investigar y mantenerse actualizado en las últimas tecnologías y tendencias en el desarrollo de aplicaciones Back-End en Java Spring.

¿Nos eliges?

Queremos contar contigo a largo plazo para que crezcas con nosotros/as (contrato indefinido) y te ofrecemos un... plan de carrera profesional apoyado por las formaciones técnicas y de gestión necesarias para lograrlo.

Además, contarás con un paquete retributivo competitivo acorde a los conocimientos y experiencia aportados, jornada intensiva los meses de julio y agosto, y todos los viernes del año, formación en idiomas, y la posibilidad de acogerte al programa de retribución flexible: Ticket Guardería, Ticket restaurante, Ticket formación, Tarjeta transporte y Seguro Médico.

También tendrás acceso a descuentos en distintos establecimientos, productos y servicios simplemente por formar parte del equipo.

¡Y muchas más cosas que queremos que conozcas!

¿Qué es lo que queremos de ti?

¡Que tengas entusiasmo por unirte a nuestro proyecto! ¡Que seas una persona comprometida y con ilusión por afrontar nuevos retos! Y sobre todo, que te apasione tanto como a nosotros la tecnología.

Requisitos

¿Qué talento buscamos?
• Grado Ingeniería Informática o Ingeniería Informática
• Ciclo en DAM / DAW
• Años de experiencia (como mínimo): 4 años

Conocimientos valorables:
• Imprescindible
• Desarrollo de proyectos con uso de APIs JSON-REST.
• Conocimiento de Spring (Boot, MVC, Core, Security, Data, Batch...)
• Valorables
• Conocimiento y experiencia en desarrollo basado en patrones de diseño “Clean Code”.
• Conocimiento en BBDD: Oracle, MySQL, PostgresSQL
• Conocimiento JPA
• Conocimiento Event Broker, preferible Kafka.

Conocimiento con sistemas de control de versiones, como Git, y metodologías ágiles de desarrollo de software.

¿Te atreves con el reto? Inscríbete, ¡te estamos buscando!

Queremos informar a todo interesado/a en nuestras ofertas de empleo que las únicas ofertas vigentes están publicadas en nuestra página web https://www.sothis.tech/portal-talento/, no debiendo confiar en portales que simplemente se limitan a agregar la información de nuestras ofertas con objeto recabar sus datos personales.

Localización (Híbrido

jobs_results.title: Junior Back-end Engineer
jobs_results.description:
We​ ​are​ ​growing​ ​again!​ ​At​ ​mediasmart​ ​we​ ​are​ ​looking​ ​for​ a ​Junior backend developer (entry-level position)​ ​to​ ​join​ ​our tech​ ​team.

We are looking for a person willing to learn our technology stack and our business. We expect a good grasp of modern Javascript but we will teach you what is needed from our stack. Reporting to the head of backend, you will partake in our backend dev team.

mediasmart started in January 2012 and is one of the most innovative platforms in the mobile programmatic advertising space. VC funded in its origin, mediasmart is now part of Affle International (Singapore), a global consumer intelligence technology company that has Microsoft, D2C (An NTT DoCoMo, Dentsu & NTT Advertising JV), Itochu, Bennett Coleman & Company (BCCL) as shareholders, and whose Indian subsidiary trades on the India stock exchanges (BSE: 542752 & NSE: AFFLE).

mediasmart has offices in Madrid, Paris, and New York. Since its inception, mediasmart has always been... very clear on its position in the mobile advertising ecosystem: full focus on advertisers and the buying process. Today we are the first programmatic platform that allows advertisers to measure the incremental impact of their drive to store and app promotion campaigns in real time, so that they can invest more in what really helps them grow their business.

mediasmart was one of the first players to enter the programmatic mobile ecosystem and to date our proprietary technology stack comprises of a DSP, DMP & Ad-Server, as well as direct connections to more than 30 ad exchanges where we buy display, video, audio and native ads on mobile apps, web, smart TV and desktop.

Our culture and values
• Be a generous leader. One that helps others succeed and celebrate their success.
• Love curiosity. Keep learning and stay relevant.
• It’s a team effort. Collaborate and cooperate to build a smart company.
• Go farther. Be an example for others. Set the bar.
• Love what we do. Love our work with passion and respect.
• Do good and do well. Our work matters.

We work hard and never forget to have fun in the process. Absolutely devoted to our customers and to building the best mobile advertising company out there, our passion shines through everything we do.

Junior Backend developer

We are looking for a person willing to learn our technology stack and our business. This is an entry level position. We expect a good grasp of modern Javascript but we will teach you what is needed from our stack. Reporting to the head of backend, you will partake in our backend dev team.

Key Responsibilities
• Develop new functionalities and maintain our product.
• Deliver new code fast and reliably, and always ensure that it works in production.
• Be able to promptly solve issues directly in the existing code.
• Proactively analyse areas to improve and propose projects to make our product more effective.

Desired Skills & Experience
• Knowledge of JavaScript and some other language.
• Some experience with Git version control.
• Basic Linux administration.
• Good communication skills, oral and written.
• Proactivity, critical thinking and good disposition for working in teams.
• Fluent in English.

Bonus Experience
• Experience with Node.js.
• Experience with Go.
• Experience with NoSQL and big data databases: BigQuery, Redis, RocksDB...
• Experience in cloud computing like AWS or GCP.
• Interest in machine learning and statistics.

Don’t worry if you lack some of the requirements; we would teach you everything needed rather than passing on the right person.

What we offer
• Competitive salary.
• Permanent contract.
• Career plan.
• Courses (related online or offline courses you might like).
• Remote work, also after COVID. Spain or LATAM preferable.
• Flexible hours.
• Join a motivated and innovative team using state of art technologies.
• Join a company with large expansion and growth projects
• Do work that makes a difference

jobs_results.title: Backend Developer
jobs_results.description: Keyfactor is one of the world's leading companies for Machine Identity, Certificate Lifecycle Management and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) Solutions. We help security teams manage cryptography as critical infrastructure by simplifying PKI including Certificate Issuance, Certificate Life Cycle Management, and Secure Code Signing.This position will work as a core member of our software development team in Barcelona Spain working on Keyfactor Signum, one of our Code Signing products. This position will have the opportunity to work on unique projects that will require strong problem solving skills and a willingness to learn new technologies. Some example projects might include:Helping the team migrate applications from .NET Framework to .NET CoreCreating new features and maintaining .NET Core applications for Windows, MacOs, and LinuxMigrating .NET Core applications to run in containerized environmentsHelping the team create and maintain software build pipelines with tools like Jenkins... and ArtifactoryThe position is based in our Barcelona office and applicants must hold a valid Right to Work in Spain.ResponsibilitiesBackend Software Development – Involves design and implementation of new features as well as maintenance and refactoring of existing features within the product code base.Basic architecture participation – Participate in design meetings to learn and provide inputParticipation in Agile ceremonies – Participate in Sprint Planning, Reviews, Retrospectives, and daily scrumsTeam collaboration – Work closely with other team members to devise solutions to code and architectural challengesOnboarding and mentoring – Participate in the onboarding and mentoring process of new employees and internsCode reviews – Submit and participate in code reviews in order to ensure standards, and improve the overall team technical aptitudeSkills and QualificationsRequired ExperienceDemonstrable professional experience in developing software applications as a team-member.Strong problem solving skills with a willingness to learn new technologies.NET Experience: Strong knowledge in both .Net Framework and .Net Core.Experience with creating and maintaining containers for production software jobs_results.description:
Perfil buscado (Hombre/Mujer)

• Collaborate with technical director, solution engineers, client managers, ensure the features are designed, and delivered according to defined business requirements and quality standards
• Responsible for core technical components development and optimization
• Implement and maintain our backend architecture for durability and quality
• Completes required coding to satisfy the defined acceptance criteria and deliver desired outcome
• Balance a fast-paced delivery schedule while ensuring quality and resilience
• Diligent to create and sustain premium quality and security of our product through modern quality tools and processes

• International Company|Important Position in the IT Department
• Bachelor´s Degree or above or commensurate industry experience.
• 7+ years of experience in Java development
• Experience with Spring / Spring Boot / Spring Cloud / Mybatis / Hibernate / JPA etc opensource framework, etc.
• Experience with high concurrency, high... availability software design and development is a plus
• Experience with code version management tools such as Git or SVN
• Experience with unit testing framework such as Junit / EasyMock / Spockframework etc
• Experience with code build tools such as Ant, Gradle or Maven etc
• Preferred but not required:
• Previous experience working for Online Travel Industry is a plus

Our client is a technology company whose mission is to make the travel business easier

through industry leading technology that empowers travel industry services. The company supports

technology for Connectivity Services at the CRS and PMS levels, Marketing Services which uses machine

learning and rich data to drive high-performing marketing campaigns and a Content platform that collects,

manages and distributes quality hotel content. Its headquarters are in the USA, with offices in Barcelona, Tokyo and Shanghai, they serve partners in 197 countries around the world.

• We offer competitive salary based on experience, annual bonuses and referral bonuses
• Peer recognition programs
• Health benefits
• Free coffee! (To recharge your batteries)
• Pension plan
• Transport and restaurant tickets
• Working from home
• Casual work environment where teamwork is key
• Nice and comfy office at the city center (Diagonal)!
• Work with passionate experts who will share their knowledge and help you develop and grow

jobs_results.title: Back-end Developer
jobs_results.description:
A Little Bit About Flanks

Flanks is a Barcelona-based fintech company focused on wealth management services. Its main product is a SaaS solution that helps financial advisors, family offices and other institutions to have a holistic view of their clients’ financial assets while using the latest scraping technology. We’re currently building the benchmark in the OpenWealth industry, and so far we managed to have compatibility with over 250 national and international entities.

Thanks to our clients, we continue to grow at a fast pace. We have already more than 300,000 aggregated portfolios spread across nearly 250 entities and have positioned our business at break-even in less than a year. In August 2021, Flanks raised €2.3 million in an investment round led by JME Ventures and SeedRocket 4Founders Capital. And a significant €7.5 million in August 2023, demonstrating confidence in our vision and capabilities.

We are pioneers in our market in Spain, which will certainly grow a lot in... the next few months and years. However, we are going to take a league leap in terms of the volumetry of the system, as our key focus now is to accelerate our market expansion in Europe and LatAm. And we would like to count on you to also grow (personally and professionally) with us.

Flanks’s values are:
• People first: To us, the most important thing is for “Flankers” to feel at ease, for them to get involved in a project and be feel part of the team.
• Keep growing: Our team believes that people growing in lockstep with the company is essential, both personally and professionally.
• Think twice, act once: We like to think about all the possible consequences before taking any decision that could affect the team or our clients.

If you’re looking to grow professionally in a very fast-growing company with an exciting start-up culture, this is your opportunity!

About The Role

You will be a Backend Developer in our company. You'll be working as a full member of the Drivers team, participating in the process of data extraction from various custodian entities. You will be working with Python as a basis and custom techniques and methodologies in order to make data extraction and processing at large scale. You will cooperate with technical and financial people in order to understand in detail what you’re processing.

Responsibilities

Examples of tasks you can expect to work on are:
• Understand and automate the login process of financial institutions websites with multi factor authentication mechanisms
• Reverse engineering of online banking websites
• All of the steps of an ETL data pipeline
• Data extraction from websites content, csv and pdf documents

Our tech stack
• Python as code base
• Browser emulation tools
• Pandas for document data parsing
• Jenkins as CI/CD
• MongoDB as data storage tool

Things we'd love to see on you
• You are a nice person: Assholes and bigotry won’t be tolerated.
• You live in Barcelona City and/or close enough to work at the office twice/three times a week. Living in Spain is a mandatory requirement, and a non-negotiable requirement.
• Likewise, we can’t offer a relocation package and/or working visa.
• You have working English and Spanish proficiency.
• You have some experience in similar roles. We're looking for someone with some lessons already learned.
• Working experience with data pipelines and scrapping.
• You are familiar with MongoDB.
• Meaningful experience with Javascript will be a huge plus.
• We will be helping you to grow, so don't worry if you don't check all the boxes!

What Can We Offer

We offer what we think is fair compensation (from 23K to 30K € per year for this role). We're on top of the market, but our intention is to increase compensation as the company grows. You will not be left behind. We believe this is a really nice time to join the project. This is a full-time, permanent contract.

A non-exhaustive list of perks includes:

🏠 Office between Sants Estació and Plaça Espanya, with a 280 degree view of Barcelona.

🔆 Flexible working hours

🎊 Paid time off on your birthday

🍒 Fresh fruit every week, all-you-can-drink tea and coffee

🍻 Friday happy hours after our weekly team meetings (optional)

😎 Team building events (optional)

🙀 Personal holidays swap inside the same month

🍽️ Digital canteen with Nora in our offices subsidized at 50%.

🏥 Health insurance

💸 Flexible remuneration with Cobee

📚 Yearly training budget

The hiring process

This is how the usual hiring process looks like:
• You send us your resume, cover letter, etc.
• A chat with our CTO Sergi Lao, where we’ll dive deeper into your background, your possible fit, and where you’ll have the opportunity to ask any sort of questions.
• We will send you a technical test so we can see how you deal with problems and how you manage Python.
• A meeting with our CTO and our CEO Joaquim de la Cruz.
• Optionally, any other meeting you or us might need to clarify any pending questions.
• We send you an offer.

We expect a few days to pass between each step. We aim for a process as short as one week and never longer than one month.

If you think you meet most of the criteria described above, don’t hesitate to send us your CV and/or cover letter. We will be happy to hear from you!

Flanks is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion both in our hiring practices and in our experiences as a Flanks employee. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage all applicants regardless of race, religion, or belief (if any), nationality, ethnic or national origin, gender, gender identity, pregnancy and maternity, sexual orientation, age, marital and civil partnership status, or disability status
